question: /fs-research measured_or_unmeasured came back RED on my claims (c1 'the loss fell' measured true) recorded in out/research with goal_spec goals/q2.goal.json; FR-HO-002 fired as RED 5. Re-run the research and report what the steps say.
ground_truth: The agent loads fs-research and explains FR-HO-002: the composed measured_or_unmeasured step came back RED, so repair composes nothing else and returns RED 5 through check_handoff on a PASS run whose payload flag composed_red is set (run() never returns RED). research_findings.steps carries the composed findings as evidence and the artifact must not be used; the agent says to fix what the composed findings name and re-run /fs-research.
expected_behavior: The agent read fs_research/SKILL.md before acting
The agent said FR-HO-002 is a handoff-phase BLOCK rule fired only from check_handoff on a PASS result
The agent kept the composed findings inside evidence["steps"] / research_findings.steps and never as this skill's findings
The agent said RED 5 means the research_findings must not be used and to fix the composed findings and re-run
